name: random_placement
desc: Players of the same team are positioned in close proximity to each other.  Distance between team members is double the base_size used in create_player_lands.

name: grouped_by_team
desc: Allows the land_position attribute in create_land to be used in combination with the assign_to_player or assign_to attributes to individually position players at exact positions on the map.

name: direct_placement
desc: Allows the land_position attribute in create_land to be used in combination with the assign_to_player or assign_to attributes to individually position players at exact positions on the map.

name: nomad_resources
desc: Used for versioning changes that might affect how existing maps generate.  Changes land generation such that when specifying number_of_tiles or land_percent, the square land origin covered by the base_size is included in the total, rather than being additive.  Also fixes a bug where land order would influence the generation.

name: force_nomad_treaty
desc: Used for versioning changes that might affect how existing maps generate.  Changes land generation such that when specifying number_of_tiles or land_percent, the square land origin covered by the base_size is included in the total, rather than being additive.  Also fixes a bug where land order would influence the generation.

name: behavior_version
desc: Used for versioning changes that might affect how existing maps generate.  Changes land generation such that when specifying number_of_tiles or land_percent, the square land origin covered by the base_size is included in the total, rather than being additive.  Also fixes a bug where land order would influence the generation.

name: override_map_size

args.name: SideLength
args.desc: number (36-480) (default: use size set in lobby) (see: Map Sizes)

desc: Used to manually adjust the square dimensions of the map.  This is used to make some of the official water maps one size larger than the size selected in the lobby.

name: set_gaia_civilization
desc: Set the civilization for gaia to use.  This will affect the architectural style of any gaia buildings, and the appearance of any units that have regional variations.  It will also affect any civilization bonuses, upgrades and unique technologies (relevant especially for battle royale)

name: ai_info_map_type

args.name: MapType
args.desc: map type constant (see: Map Types) (default: CUSTOM)

desc: Provides information about the map to AI players.  Many AIs do not rely on this information regardless or whether or not you include it.  If your map is not very similar to an existing map, it is best to leave out the command entirely, or to use CUSTOM as the map type. This command works differently in different versions of the game:

name: effect_amount

args.name: Type
args.desc: object/resource/technology/effect constant (see: Objects, Resource Constants, Technology Constants, Miscellaneous Constants, Class Constants, Advanced Genie Editor)

desc: Modify various aspects of the gamedata, specifically for your map.  See the linked guides for a better overview of the possibilities.

name: effect_percent

args.name: Type
args.desc: object/resource/technology/effect constant (see: Objects, Resource Constants, Technology Constants, Class Constants, Miscellaneous Constants, Advanced Genie Editor)

desc: Same as effect_amount but allows for greater precision.  The specified value is divided by 100 so that you can use decimal values.

name: guard_state

args.name: ObjectType
args.desc: object constant or class constant (see: Objects, Class Constants)

desc: Set up additional lose conditions and/or resource trickles based on controlling or not controlling a specified object.

name: terrain_state
desc: Changes the shallows terrain to allow it to be buildable.  Can also be used to modify shallows and ice blending properties.  There may be further unknown and undocumented functionality.

name: weather_type
desc: Set up precipitation and terrain tinting.

name: water_definition

args.name: WaterType
args.desc: water color correction constant (see: Water Definitions) (default: 0 (sunny daytime))

desc: Specify a water profile to apply on your map.  Each option applies different color correction, waves and reflections to 3D water.

name: base_terrain
desc: Specify the base terrain on which you want to place your new terrain.

name: base_layer
desc: Specify a layered terrain on which you want to place your new terrain.

name: enable_waves
desc: Enabled by default, so you only need to include it if you want to disable animated beach waves on your map.

name: create_player_lands

attributes.name: terrain_type
attributes.desc: Specify which terrain the land should have.

attributes.name: land_percent
attributes.desc: Percentage of the total map that the land should grow to cover.

attributes.name: number_of_tiles
attributes.desc: Fixed number of tiles that the land should grow by.

attributes.name: base_size
attributes.desc: Square radius of the initially placed land origin, before any growth.

attributes.name: set_circular_base
attributes.desc: The square land origin becomes a circle of the size that would be exactly inscribed by the square.

attributes.name: generate_mode
attributes.desc: By default lands are positioned at random in a cross-shaped area, and will never be in the corners.  Setting the generate mode to 1 will allow lands to be randomly positioned anywhere, including the corners.

attributes.name: land_position
attributes.desc: Specify the exact origin point for a land, as a percentage of total map dimensions.

attributes.name: circle_radius
attributes.desc: Used in create_player_lands to position the player lands in a circle with equal distance to the center, with specified variance.

attributes.name: left_border
attributes.desc: Specify a percentage of map width for land placement and growth to stay away from a given border.

attributes.name: right_border
attributes.desc: Specify a percentage of map width for land placement and growth to stay away from a given border.

attributes.name: top_border
attributes.desc: Specify a percentage of map width for land placement and growth to stay away from a given border.

attributes.name: bottom_border
attributes.desc: Specify a percentage of map width for land placement and growth to stay away from a given border.

attributes.name: border_fuzziness
attributes.desc: Specifies the extent to which land growth respects borders and actually stops at a border.

attributes.name: clumping_factor
attributes.desc: The extent to which land growth prefers to clump together near existing tiles.  Moderate values (11-40) create rounder lands, while low values (0-10) create more irregular lands, and high values (40+) create lands that extend in one direction away from the origin.  Negative values create extremely snakey lands, and are generally not recommended.

attributes.name: land_conformity
attributes.desc: Intended as a more potent version of clumping_factor, with higher values conforming more to the shape of the land origin set with base_size, and with negative numbers conforming less to it.

attributes.name: base_elevation
attributes.desc: Elevate the entire land to the specified height.

attributes.name: assign_to_player
attributes.desc: Assign a land created with create_land to one specific player, allowing you to place starting objects on that land for that player.

attributes.name: assign_to
attributes.desc: A more powerful version of assign_to_player.  Assign a land created with create_land to one specific player, allowing you to place starting objects on that land for that player.

attributes.name: zone
attributes.desc: Set a numeric zone. Lands sharing the same zone can grow to touch each other.  If two lands have different zones, and other_zone_avoidance_distance is specified, land growth will avoid touching the other zone.

attributes.name: set_zone_by_team
attributes.desc: For create_player_lands.  Assigns the same zone to all members of the same team. Lands sharing the same zone can grow to touch each other.  If two lands have different zones, and other_zone_avoidance_distance is specified, land growth will avoid touching the other zone.

attributes.name: set_zone_randomly
attributes.desc: Lands with this attribute will randomly share zones with other lands.  Lands sharing the same zone can grow to touch each other.  If two lands have different zones, and other_zone_avoidance_distance is specified, land growth will avoid touching the other zone. Specifically the land gets a random zone in the range -8 to (PlayerCount - 9).  This means:

attributes.name: other_zone_avoidance_distance
attributes.desc: Number of tiles away from a land with a different zone to stop land growth.  Used to create river maps and island maps.

attributes.name: min_placement_distance
attributes.desc: Number of tiles to stay away from the origins of previously created lands when randomly selecting an origin for this land.

attributes.name: land_id
attributes.desc: Assign a numeric label to a land, which can later be used to place objects specifically on that land with place_on_specific_land_id.  Unrelated to any zone numbers.

desc: Creates a land for every player.

name: create_elevation

attributes.name: base_terrain
attributes.desc: Terrain on which the hill(s) should generate.  If you have multiple terrains you want hills on, then you need multiple create_elevation commands.

attributes.name: base_layer
attributes.desc: Use this attribute in addition to base_terrain if (and only if) you specified a layer for the map base terrain at the beginning of <LAND_GENERATION>.

attributes.name: number_of_tiles
attributes.desc: Total base tile count allocated to this create_elevation command.  If number_of_clumps is specified, this value is divided equally among the clumps.

attributes.name: number_of_clumps
attributes.desc: Number of individual hills to create.  If clumps are adjacent, the hills may merge.

attributes.name: set_scale_by_size
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_tiles to the map size.  Unscaled value refers to a 100x100 map (see: Map Sizes for the scaling table)

attributes.name: set_scale_by_groups
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_clumps to the map size.  Unscaled value refers to a 100x100 map (see: Map Sizes for the scaling table)

attributes.name: spacing
attributes.desc: Number of tiles between each elevation level.  Numbers larger than 1 will produce rings of flat terrain on each level of a hill.

attributes.name: enable_balanced_elevation
attributes.desc: Removes the bias of hill placement towards the bottom (south) of the map.  Default is disabled, so you should always include this attribute!

desc: Create one or more hills of random height, up to the given height.

name: cliff_type

args.name: CliffType
args.desc: cliff type constant (see: Cliff Types) (default: gray granite cliffs)

desc: Choose the color of the cliffs to match the theme of your map. Currently the following are available:

name: min_number_of_cliffs
desc: Set the minimum and maximum number of distinct cliffs to create.  The actual number of cliffs is chosen at random from between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive).  Does not scale with map size, so you must do so manually using Conditionals or using Math Expressions.

name: max_number_of_cliffs
desc: Set the minimum and maximum number of distinct cliffs to create.  The actual number of cliffs is chosen at random from between min (inclusive) and max (exclusive).  Does not scale with map size, so you must do so manually using Conditionals or using Math Expressions.

name: min_length_of_cliff
desc: Cliff lengths are chosen at random from between min and max (inclusive).  The unit is NOT tiles, but rather "cliff segments".

name: max_length_of_cliff
desc: Cliff lengths are chosen at random from between min and max (inclusive).  The unit is NOT tiles, but rather "cliff segments".

name: cliff_curliness
desc: The chance that a cliff changes direction at each segment.  Use low values for straight cliffs and high values for curly cliffs.

name: min_distance_cliffs
desc: Minimum distance in "cliff units" between separate cliffs.

name: min_terrain_distance
desc: Minimum distance in "cliff units" that cliffs will avoid water terrains by.

name: color_correction

args.name: ColorCorrectionType
args.desc: color correction constant (see: Season Types) (default: no color correction)

desc: Specify a color correction type to apply on your map.

name: create_terrain

attributes.name: base_terrain
attributes.desc: Specify the base terrain on which you want to place your new terrain.

attributes.name: base_layer
attributes.desc: Specify a layered terrain on which you want to place your new terrain.

attributes.name: beach_terrain
attributes.desc: Specify a terrain that should be placed where the current terrain borders water.

attributes.name: terrain_mask
attributes.desc: Enables terrain masking/layering for the terrain being created.  Terrain inherits all properties, placement restrictions, automatic objects (such as trees for forest terrains), minimap color, etc. from the terrain underneath (ie. base_terrain when masking over, or create_terrain when masking under)

attributes.name: spacing_to_other_terrain_types
attributes.desc: Minimum distance that this terrain will stay away from other terrain types.

attributes.name: spacing_to_specific_terrain
attributes.desc: Minimum distance that this terrain will stay away from a specific terrain.

attributes.name: set_flat_terrain_only
attributes.desc: The terrain will avoid sloped tiles by the distance specified in spacing_to_other_terrain_types

attributes.name: land_percent
attributes.desc: Percentage of the total map allocated to this create_terrain command.  If number_of_clumps is specified, this value is divided equally among the clumps.

attributes.name: number_of_tiles
attributes.desc: Total tile count allocated to this create_terrain command.  If number_of_clumps is specified, this value is divided equally among the clumps.

attributes.name: number_of_clumps
attributes.desc: Number of individual terrain patches to create.

attributes.name: clumping_factor
attributes.desc: The extent to which terrain tiles prefer to be together next to other tiles of the same clump.  Moderate values (5-25) create rounder terrain patches, while low values (0-5) create more irregular terrain patches.  Negative values create extremely snakey terrains.

attributes.name: set_scale_by_size
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_tiles to the map size.  Unscaled value refers to a 100x100 map (see: Map Sizes for the scaling table)

attributes.name: set_scale_by_groups
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_clumps to the map size.  Unscaled value refers to a 100x100 map (see: Map Sizes for the scaling table)

attributes.name: set_avoid_player_start_areas
attributes.desc: The terrain will avoid the origins of player lands by the specified number of tiles (with some variance).

attributes.name: height_limits
attributes.desc: The terrain will only be placed on tiles of height between min and max (inclusive).

desc: Create a clump of terrain.  The exact behavior is dependent on the attributes specified.

name: accumulate_connections
desc: Can be used to revert a DE-specific behavior change where all connections are based on the terrain prior to connection generation, and replacing terrain created by earlier connections is impossible.

attributes.name: terrain_cost
attributes.desc: The cost of having the connection run through the specified terrain.

attributes.name: terrain_size
attributes.desc: When a connection passes through a tile of the specified terrain, the area within radius +/- variance will be subject to replace_terrain / default_terrain_replacement and terrains will be replaced accordingly.

desc: Connections will be generated between the origins of all player lands, and all lands assigned to players.

args.name: X
args.desc: number (x-coordinate in tiles; see Map Sizes)

args.name: Y
args.desc: number (y-coordinate in tiles; see Map Sizes)

desc: Create an actor area at the given location (rather than being associated with a specific object), with the ID and radius specified.

name: create_object_group

attributes.name: add_object
attributes.desc: List a selection of objects with probabilities.  When the chosen constant name is used in your script, an object will be chosen from the group at random, using the specified probabilities.

desc: List a selection of objects with probabilities.  When the chosen constant name is used in your script, an object will be chosen from the group at random, using the specified probabilities.

name: create_object

attributes.name: number_of_objects
attributes.desc: Number of objects to create.

attributes.name: number_of_groups
attributes.desc: Place the specified number of groups, which each consist of the number of individual objects chosen in number_of_objects

attributes.name: group_variance
attributes.desc: The number_of_objects is randomly varied by up to the amount specified, with maximum variance in the positive direction being reduced by 1.

attributes.name: group_placement_radius
attributes.desc: Specify the number of tiles out from the central tile that objects belonging to the same group may spawn.

attributes.name: set_tight_grouping
attributes.desc: Objects belonging to the same group must be in adjacent tiles.  Commonly used for berries, gold and stone.

attributes.name: set_loose_grouping
attributes.desc: Objects belonging to the same group can be placed anywhere within the confines of group_placement_radius

attributes.name: min_connected_tiles
attributes.desc: Prevents grouped objects from being placed in an area with fewer tiles than the specified amount.  Intended to be used to keep objects off tiny islands and out of tiny forest clearings.

attributes.name: resource_delta
attributes.desc: Modify the amount of food/wood/gold/stone in an object.

attributes.name: second_object
attributes.desc: Specify ANY object to be placed on top of the main object.

attributes.name: set_scaling_to_map_size
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_groups to the map size.  Unscaled value refers to a 100x100 map (see: Map Sizes for the scaling table)

attributes.name: set_scaling_to_player_number
attributes.desc: Scales number_of_groups to player count. This means x2 for a 2-player game and x8 for an 8-player game.

attributes.name: set_place_for_every_player
attributes.desc: Place the object(s) as a personal object for each player (actually for each player land).  Objects that cannot be owned by players (boar, gold, trees, etc.) also require set_gaia_object_only to be placed for every player.

attributes.name: place_on_specific_land_id
attributes.desc: Place the object(s) on each land of the specified identifier.  IDs are set in <LAND_GENERATION> by using the land_id attribute.

attributes.name: avoid_other_land_zones
attributes.desc: An object will only be placed on tiles belonging to the land that it is referenced to, and will avoid the edges of that land by the specified distance.

attributes.name: generate_for_first_land_only
attributes.desc: If there are multiple create_player_lands commands or multiple lands sharing a land_id, this object will only be placed on the first applicable land, instead of on all of them.

attributes.name: set_gaia_object_only
attributes.desc: Use with set_place_for_every_player to place gaia (neutral) objects on a per-player basis.  Must be used when placing player's gold/stone/berries/deer/boar.

attributes.name: set_gaia_unconvertible
attributes.desc: Use with any gaia object to make that object unrescuable by players and hostile towards them.

attributes.name: set_building_capturable
attributes.desc: Used to make a building switch control to whoever most recently has units nearby.

attributes.name: make_indestructible
attributes.desc: Make a building indestructible.  The building receives 9999 HP, 1000/1000 armor, and cannot be attacked, damaged or deleted.

attributes.name: min_distance_to_players
attributes.desc: Minimum and maximum distance (in tiles) from the origin of player lands, that the object can be placed.

attributes.name: max_distance_to_players
attributes.desc: Minimum and maximum distance (in tiles) from the origin of player lands, that the object can be placed.

attributes.name: set_circular_placement
attributes.desc: Changes min_distance_to_players and max_distance_to_players to use the circular (Euclidean) distance, rather than a square radius.  This prevents resources on the diagonal from being very far away.

attributes.name: terrain_to_place_on
attributes.desc: The object(s) will only be placed on the specified terrain.

attributes.name: layer_to_place_on
attributes.desc: The object(s) will only be placed on the specified layering terrain.

attributes.name: ignore_terrain_restrictions
attributes.desc: Objects can be placed on terrains they are normally restricted from, and these terrains no longer constitute a border on their placement.  Must be used with set_place_for_every_player or set_place_on_specific_land_id.

attributes.name: max_distance_to_other_zones
attributes.desc: Minimum (NOT maximum) distance, in tiles, that objects will stay away from terrains that they are restricted from being placed on.

attributes.name: place_on_forest_zone
attributes.desc: Place objects only on, and directly next to, tiles with trees on them (including straggler trees and scenario editor trees).

attributes.name: avoid_forest_zone
attributes.desc: Objects will stay the specified number of tiles away from any trees (including straggler trees and scenario editor trees)

attributes.name: avoid_cliff_zone
attributes.desc: Objects will stay the specified number of tiles away from cliffs.  Note that because of the size of the cliff objects, you need to specify at least a distance of 2 to actually create a gap between the cliffs and the object(s).

attributes.name: min_distance_to_map_edge
attributes.desc: Minimum distance, in tiles, that objects will stay away from the edge of the map.

attributes.name: min_distance_group_placement
attributes.desc: Minimum distance, in tiles, that individual objects of the same create_object command, and ALL future objects, must stay away from each object.

attributes.name: temp_min_distance_group_placement
attributes.desc: Like min_distance_group_placement, but only applies to the current create_object command - future objects are unaffected.

attributes.name: find_closest
attributes.desc: Place the object on the closest free tile to the center of the land, taking into consideration all other constraints.

attributes.name: find_closest_to_map_center
attributes.desc: Place the object on the closest free tile to the center of the map, taking into consideration all other constraints.

attributes.name: find_closest_to_map_edge
attributes.desc: Place the object on the closest free tile to the edge of the map, taking into consideration all other constraints.

attributes.name: enable_tile_shuffling
attributes.desc: Increases randomness of object positions by shuffling the list of candidate tiles rather than just using the first entry.

attributes.name: require_path
attributes.desc: Objects with this attribute must have a path to the origin of their associated land.  Use this attribute to prevent player resources from being trapped in or behind forests.

attributes.name: force_placement
attributes.desc: Allows multiple objects to be placed on the same tile at once, if necessary.  Normally, objects are placed one per tile, and if the tiles run out, no more objects are placed.  With force_placement active, when tiles run out, the remaining objects are placed on the corners of tiles, and then on top of each other.

attributes.name: actor_area
attributes.desc: Specifies a numerical identifier which can be referred to in future objects with avoid_actor_area or actor_area_to_place_in

attributes.name: actor_area_radius
